_comment: ACCEPTED FINDINGS -- the kit's known defect debt, as measured by tools/harness.py. tools/verify/verify_findings.py fails on anything NOT in this file, so a new dead control, a new raise, or a new layout spill breaks the build instead of printing into a run nobody reads. It also fails on entries here that no longer occur: debt that was paid and not written off makes the list longer than the kit's real problem, which is how a defect register stops being read. A signature is 'page | category | label' -- the harness's own ids renumber whenever a page changes, and a label is what a maintainer actually searches for. ADDING TO THIS FILE IS ACCEPTING A DEFECT. Do it deliberately, and prefer fixing. Signatures are NORMALISED: generated row ids collapse to '#', so a family of identical row spills is one entry rather than twenty-three unstable ones. Counts are recorded but NOT compared -- how many rows a walk builds is a property of the walk, not of the kit (ADR-110). A NEW signature is the regression.

known.selection-log.html: row2 spills at 390px once a record is in the row -- the flex-chain repair ADR-103 named and left; 37px is the worst in the kit
known.survey-design.html: the same row2 family, 9px, on the copy/remove controls of each row
known.ecology-lab.html: four Workbench textarea fills time out under the walk; the controls work by hand, so either the harness's fill is wrong for that control or the control is, and nobody has measured which
known.stand-sheet.html: 'Add photos' leaves no observable trace -- the one genuinely dead control left after ADR-110 cleared ten false ones

_written_off: 2026-08-31 (ADR-111): the four ecology-lab 'failed | <textarea sample text>' entries are struck. They were never defects in the page. The textareas sit inside a collapsed <details> and the harness's discovery called them visible while its driver could not act on them, so a fill timed out and was filed as 'action raised'. One visibility oracle, and they are now correctly HIDDEN with a reason. Debt written off because it was measured away, not because it was tolerated.
